environment.description: Production Celery worker cluster running on ECS Fargate. The Split relay proxy Redis cache has the flag 'worker-verbose-logging' set to treatment='on' for all traffic segments (enabled during a debugging session two weeks ago and never reverted). Logs are shipped to CloudWatch Logs via Fluent Bit without any log sanitization layer. Workers process events from an SQS queue where message payloads originate from unauthenticated webhook endpoints.
